response.overview: Ascension is a double-DVD live concert document by The Chameleons, released in 2006. It was filmed at The Great American Music Hall in San Francisco, October 16–18, 2002, and the recordings are owned by The Chameleons/Scourge Productions.  It's a double DVD from the band's 2002 US tour, clocking in at three and a half hours with more than 30 songs, including "Swamp Thing," "Soul In Isolation" and "Don't Fall," plus interview footage and secret tracks.  Most of the footage comes from two nights at the Great American Music Hall, and the second night features a "stripped down" set with rarer tracks from the band's back catalogue.
response.title: The Chameleons: Ascension
